units.note: All coordinates in pyxl units. 1 pyxl = 10px render. Hip-local origin = sacralpoint (center of ∞ / SI joint).

sacralpoint.note: Center of ∞ / SI joint. Backbone attachment. Hipbone origin. Bendable flex point.

left_hippoint.note: Left iliac crest / hip bone top. 0.75 heads from center (1.5 heads total span, matches shoulders). 0.5H above sacralpoint.

right_hippoint.note: Right iliac crest / hip bone top. 0.75 heads from center (1.5 heads total span, matches shoulders). 0.5H above sacralpoint.

left_socket.note: Left hip socket / femur attachment. Outer bottom lobe of ∞. 0.25H below sacralpoint, 0.5× hip width from center.

right_socket.note: Right hip socket / femur attachment. Outer bottom lobe of ∞. 0.25H below sacralpoint, 0.5× hip width from center.

segments.note: Left iliac crest — rises up and out from sacrum
Right iliac crest — rises up and out from sacrum

shapes.note: ∞ / figure-8 hip shape. Sacralpoint at center crossing (0,0). Iliac crests at top lobes (-18.75,-16.5) / (18.75,-16.5). Hip sockets at bottom lobes (±9.375, 8.25). Total height 33 pyxl = 1.0H (crest to socket_bottom). Crest rise above sacrum: 16.5 pyxl / 0.5H.
Sacral / SI joint. Center of ∞. Backbone attachment. Bendable flex point.

backbone.note: sacralpoint = hippoint in assembled space. Backbone plugs into center of ∞.

sacralpoint.note: Center of ∞ / SI joint. Backbone attachment. Bendable flex point.

flex.note: Bendable at sacralpoint (center of ∞), tilts pelvis.

meta.derived_from: Pyxl.Papyr proportional rules — hip width = shoulder width = 1.5H / 37.5 pyxl, crest rise = 0.5H / 16.5 pyxl
meta.changelog: v1: Initial hipbone. ∞ / figure-8 shape. Sacralpoint center (0,0), iliac crests ±18.75, -16.5 (0.5H above sacrum, 1.5H total span). Hip sockets ±9.375, 8.25 (0.25H below sacrum). Total hip piece height 33 pyxl / 1.0H crest-to-socket.
meta.rounding_note: socket Y = 8.25 pyxl below sacrum = 0.25H (exempt from Pyxl rounding)
